observed_problem_fact: Describe counting by value-indexed counters and return a frequency array with 100 elements.
derived_algorithm: Direct-address frequency array; membership-only specialization can use occupancy bits.
applicable_contract: Dense bounded-integer counting, membership and bulk sorted reconstruction.
time_complexity: O(n+U) counting and ordered reconstruction; O(1) individual counter update.
auxiliary_space: O(U) counters; occupancy alone uses U bits but loses multiplicity.
constraints: Domain size governs space and scan cost; unrestricted/sparse keys can be unsuitable; distinguish a legal zero payload from absence and preserve count-overflow policy.

observed_problem_fact: Order integer-associated strings while retaining original order among equal keys.
derived_algorithm: Count, prefix offsets and stable scatter over keys/handles; possible radix-pass building block.
applicable_contract: Stable bounded-key batch ordering and primitive-key payload permutation.
auxiliary_space: O(n+U) auxiliary storage for straightforward stable scatter.
constraints: Requires a bounded digit/key domain; signed order and arbitrary comparators need separate treatment; stable ties and payload identity must be preserved; task-specific replacement of text is not a collection requirement.

observed_problem_fact: Report the running median after each input; the official task encourages use of heaps.
derived_algorithm: Balanced lower max-heap and upper min-heap stored in arrays.
applicable_contract: Running-median specialization over primitive numeric values.
time_complexity: O(log n) heap work per insertion; O(1) median query, excluding backing-array growth.
constraints: Retain size balance and cross-heap ordering; arbitrary deletion, sorted traversal, callbacks and concurrency are additional unsupported contracts.

observed_problem_fact: Return an insertion-cost total based on counts strictly below/above each inserted integer; values are bounded by 100000.
derived_algorithm: Frequency/Fenwick counters over a bounded or explicitly compressed ordered domain.
applicable_contract: Rank/count queries, bounded multisets and insertion statistics.
time_complexity: O(log U) counter update and prefix query.
auxiliary_space: O(U) counters; offline compression adds preprocessing and mapping storage.
constraints: The required result is a cost total, not a physically sorted online container; compression cannot silently absorb arbitrary new keys; counters need overflow and nonnegative-count rules.

challenge_title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
observed_problem_fact: Find a positional kth largest value, counting duplicates; the task asks whether full sorting can be avoided.
derived_algorithm: Size-k array heap or an explicitly bounded partition-selection variant.
applicable_contract: Top-k or one-shot order-statistic consumers that do not require full sorted order.
time_complexity: Size-k heap: O(n log k); naive deterministic quickselect can be O(n^2) worst case.
auxiliary_space: O(k) heap workspace; partition workspace depends on selected implementation.
constraints: Partitioning can reorder payloads; preserve encounter order via an index/copy where required; do not claim worst-case linear selection without an algorithm providing it.

observed_problem_fact: Return the maximum for each fixed-width window as it advances across an integer array.
derived_algorithm: Monotone deque of candidate indices stored in a ring array.
applicable_contract: Moving-window maximum/minimum consumers with monotone expiry.
time_complexity: O(n) total; amortized O(1) update, but a single update can discard O(k) candidates.
constraints: Requires monotone window expiry and only the supported extremum query; cannot replace arbitrary sorted enumeration or unrelated deletes.

observed_problem_fact: Compact sorted input to a unique prefix while retaining relative order.
derived_algorithm: Stable read/write cursors retain one representative from each adjacent equivalent run.
applicable_contract: Sorted-set construction; deduplicate sorted batches or primitive list prefixes.
auxiliary_space: O(1) scalar workspace for a plain mutable array.
constraints: Requires sorted input under the chosen equivalence; comparator equality and Object.equals may differ; clear retired reference slots and preserve representative/epoch semantics.

observed_problem_fact: Remove every occurrence of a chosen value; the task explicitly permits reordering.
derived_algorithm: Stable filter-compaction for ordered owners; separately admissible swap-delete for unordered owners.
applicable_contract: removeIf, retain/filter operations and caller-computed mask compaction.
auxiliary_space: O(1) cursor state for pure predicates; staged exception-safe decisions may require a mask.
constraints: Task-permitted reordering is not an ordered-collection contract; preserve callback order, failure/partial-commit behavior and reference clearing; zero/null may be valid data.

observed_problem_fact: Maintain the median under integer insertions; follow-up asks about a domain restricted to 0 through 100.
derived_algorithm: Two array heaps, or direct frequency counters for an admitted small domain.
time_complexity: Two heaps: O(log n) insertion and O(1) median; counts: O(1) update and O(U) median scan.
constraints: Heap growth is separate; preserve size balance and partition order; widened arithmetic is needed for even-size integer medians; does not provide general ordered navigation.

challenge_title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
observed_problem_fact: For each position, report how many smaller values occur to its right.
derived_algorithm: Right-to-left Fenwick counts or indexed merge-counting.
applicable_contract: Batch ranks, inversion accounting and permutation analysis.
time_complexity: O(n log U) with a bounded-domain Fenwick array; O(n log n) with merge-counting.
auxiliary_space: O(U) counters plus output, or O(n) merge workspace.
constraints: Batch/right-to-left observation differs from an online container contract; coordinate compression needs a known domain or rebuild; equal values are excluded from smaller counts.

challenge_title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
observed_problem_fact: Return both boundaries of a target in sorted input, including an absent result; O(log n) search is required.
applicable_contract: Equal ranges, duplicate counts, bounded navigation and range-removal boundaries.
time_complexity: O(log n) comparisons for boundaries; enumerating r matches adds O(r).
constraints: Distinguish inclusive/exclusive endpoints and comparator equality; cached logical positions do not automatically remain valid for live backed views.

observed_problem_fact: Find an existing or would-be insertion position in a sorted distinct integer array; O(log n) search is required.
derived_algorithm: Binary-search lower bound over a sorted logical range.
applicable_contract: Sorted arrays, block maxima directories, floor/ceiling preparation and merge boundaries.
time_complexity: O(log n) comparisons for the position; physical packed insertion can remain O(n).
constraints: Generalize distinct integers to comparator equivalence and duplicate policy explicitly; preserve bounds and overflow-safe midpoint arithmetic.

observed_problem_fact: Insert into sorted nonoverlapping intervals and coalesce overlaps; intervals sharing a point overlap.
derived_algorithm: Ordered interval splice and coalescing scan.
applicable_contract: Range-set normalization, occupied/free extents and batched range edits.
time_complexity: O(n) scan/output in the straightforward packed implementation.
auxiliary_space: O(n) output if rebuilding; in-place variants have separate capacity and movement costs.
constraints: Official closed-interval overlap is not M3 half-open semantics; define adjacency policy and extrema behavior without end+1 overflow; no generic NavigableSet equivalence.

observed_problem_fact: Implement front/rear insertion, removal and access for a bounded deque.
derived_algorithm: Ring array with head, size and wrap arithmetic.
applicable_contract: FIFO/deque and bounded worklist storage with no element link object.
time_complexity: O(1) end operations at fixed capacity; a growable variant has separate resize costs.
auxiliary_space: O(C) reserved element storage and O(1) scalar state.
constraints: Mask wrapping requires power-of-two capacity; preserve full/empty and null/exception policies; iterator identities, concurrent publication and growth are additional contracts.

observed_problem_fact: Merge two sorted integer prefixes into the first array, which has sufficient trailing capacity; follow-up requests linear time.
derived_algorithm: Two-cursor sorted merge; backward writes when the destination has reserved space.
applicable_contract: Bulk sorted primitive map/set/list updates; merge snapshots with an explicit duplicate policy.
time_complexity: O(n+b) merge; sorting an unsorted batch separately costs O(b log b) comparisons.
auxiliary_space: O(1) scalar workspace only with sufficient destination capacity and safe source aliasing; allocation otherwise explicit.
constraints: Preserve comparator order, validation before mutation, key representatives, duplicate winner policy and allocation-failure behavior; does not establish logarithmic single insertion.
